root_cause: The datepicker formats the input value to a locale-specific date string during initialization, altering the submitted value when the user does not pick a date.
repair_strategy: Conditionally update the input/display only when there are preselected dates, preserving the original ISO format value when no date is chosen.
expected_accessibility_effect: No change to keyboard navigation or screen reader behavior; the date field remains usable and its value format remains consistent.
functional_risks: Preselected dates (if any) will still be displayed because the guard checks selectedDates length.
If other code depends on the formatted input value for non-datepicker logic, it may need adjustment, but internal state uses selectedDates.
verification_requirements: After tabbing through the departure field without selecting a date, the submitted departure value must remain in yyyy-mm-dd format.
When a date is selected via the calendar, the input must update to the formatted locale string.
If the page includes preselected dates via data-bs-selected-dates, those dates must be displayed correctly.
